verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KU Lunaku olukulu,
Yesu lw'alirabika;
Alitukung'anya fenna,
Abaana be

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ebitundu byaffe byonna,
Omubiri n'omwoyo,
Biritwalibwa-eyo gy'ali,
Mu ggulu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bijja kwawulibwa mu nsi,
Ekiseera-ekitono,
Omubiri ne gwebaka,
Bwebasi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Era omwoyo ogutafa,
Ne gubeerawo gwokka,
Nga gukyamulindiridde,
-Okujja kwe.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Naye ku lunaku olwo,
Birigattirwa ddala,
Omubiri nga gwambadde,
-Obutafa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
-Essanyu lyaffe nga liriba,
Lingi ku lunaku lwe,
Bwe tulimulaba Yesu,
Mu ggulu.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Ayi Mukma waffe Yesu,
-Otulung'amyenga fenna,
Mu kkubo eriritutuusa,
Ewuwo
